suites.title: AE-3 Brands in the catalogue API and shop, and the Contact Us form

specs.title: SCN-001: The brands list has the agreed shape

steps.title: Given the public catalogue API is reachable
When I request GET /api/brandsList
Then the HTTP status is 200
And the body responseCode is 200
And the body has a "brands" array
And every entry has an "id" and a "brand"

specs.title: SCN-002: Every brandsList entry names the brand of the product with that id

steps.title: Given I read the catalogue with GET /api/productsList
[SEED] read the catalogue (GET /api/productsList)
When I request GET /api/brandsList
Then for every entry, the product with that id in GET /api/productsList has exactly that brand
And there is exactly one entry per catalogue product

specs.title: SCN-003.1: Unsupported methods on the brands list are refused in the body (PUT)

steps.title: Given the public catalogue API is reachable
When I send PUT /api/brandsList
Then the HTTP status is 200
And the body responseCode is 405 with message "This request method is not supported."

specs.title: SCN-003.2: Unsupported methods on the brands list are refused in the body (POST)

steps.title: Given the public catalogue API is reachable
When I send POST /api/brandsList
Then the HTTP status is 200
And the body responseCode is 405 with message "This request method is not supported."

specs.title: SCN-003.3: Unsupported methods on the brands list are refused in the body (DELETE)

steps.title: Given the public catalogue API is reachable
When I send DELETE /api/brandsList
Then the HTTP status is 200
And the body responseCode is 405 with message "This request method is not supported."

specs.title: SCN-004: The Brands panel lists each brand once with its product count

steps.title: Given I am on the Products page
When I read the "Brands" panel in the left-hand sidebar
Then each brand entry shows the number of its products in parentheses, e.g. "(6)"
And no brand is listed more than once

specs.title: SCN-005: The Brands panel matches the brands list of the API

steps.title: Given I read the brands with GET /api/brandsList
[SEED] read the brands (GET /api/brandsList)
And I am on the Products page
When I read the "Brands" panel in the left-hand sidebar
Then the brands in the panel are exactly the distinct brand names in brandsList
And the number next to each brand equals the number of brandsList entries with that brand

specs.title: SCN-006.1: A brand's page lists exactly that brand's products (Polo)

steps.title: Given I read the catalogue with GET /api/productsList
[SEED] read the catalogue (GET /api/productsList)
And I am on the Products page
When I click "Polo" in the "Brands" panel
Then the page is headed "Brand - Polo Products"
And the page lists exactly the products that productsList gives "Polo"

specs.title: SCN-006.2: A brand's page lists exactly that brand's products (H&M)

steps.title: Given I read the catalogue with GET /api/productsList
[SEED] read the catalogue (GET /api/productsList)
And I am on the Products page
When I click "H&M" in the "Brands" panel
Then the page is headed "Brand - H&M Products"
And the page lists exactly the products that productsList gives "H&M"

specs.title: SCN-006.3: A brand's page lists exactly that brand's products (Mast & Harbour)

steps.title: Given I read the catalogue with GET /api/productsList
[SEED] read the catalogue (GET /api/productsList)
And I am on the Products page
When I click "Mast & Harbour" in the "Brands" panel
Then the page is headed "Brand - Mast & Harbour Products"
And the page lists exactly the products that productsList gives "Mast & Harbour"

specs.title: SCN-007: The Contact Us form offers the mock-up's fields

steps.title: Given I am on the Contact Us page
When I look at the "Get In Touch" form
Then it offers a Name field with placeholder "Name"
And it offers an Email field with placeholder "Email"
And it offers a Subject field with placeholder "Subject"
And it offers a multi-line Message field with placeholder "Your Message Here"
And it offers a "Submit" button

specs.title: SCN-008: The form is not sent while the mandatory Email is empty

steps.title: Given I am on the Contact Us page
And I filled Name, Subject and Message with unique values and left Email empty
When I click "Submit" and accept any confirmation
Then no success message is shown
And the form is still on the page

specs.title: SCN-009: The form is not sent with an e-mail that is not a valid address

steps.title: Given I am on the Contact Us page
And I filled Name, Subject and Message with unique values and Email with "not-an-email"
When I click "Submit" and accept any confirmation
Then no success message is shown
And the form is still on the page

specs.title: SCN-010: The form can be sent with only a valid Email

steps.title: Given I am on the Contact Us page
And I filled only Email with a unique valid address
When I click "Submit" and confirm with OK
Then the success message is shown

specs.title: SCN-011: Sending the form asks for confirmation, shows success and offers a Home button

steps.title: Given I am on the Contact Us page
And I filled Name, Email, Subject and Message with unique valid values
When I click "Submit"
Then a browser confirmation "Press OK to proceed!" is shown
When I confirm with OK
Then the message "Success! Your details have been submitted successfully." is shown
And the form is replaced by a "Home" button
When I click "Home"
Then I am on the home page

specs.title: SCN-012: Cancelling the confirmation keeps the form as filled

steps.title: Given I am on the Contact Us page
And I filled Name, Email, Subject and Message with unique valid values
When I click "Submit" and cancel the confirmation
Then no success message is shown
And the form is still on the page
And every field still holds what I typed
